title: ShutterCount Camera Health Shutter Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shuttercount:camera shutter_count=*
| stats sum(shutter_count) as total_value, avg(shutter_count) as avg_value by camera_body
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks camera body values by total and average shutter count across ShutterCount camera health events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `shutter_count` values for each ShutterCount camera health event and review total and average shutter count by camera body.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total shutter count.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which camera body shows the biggest shutter count numbers in your ShutterCount camera health data.
